Appleton Partners Lowered Its Stake in Apple Com (AAPL) by $418,836; Ball (BLL) Holder Corsair Capital Management LP Has Increased Holding
June 14, 2018 - By Michael Collier
Appleton Partners Inc decreased its stake in Apple Inc Com (AAPL) by 1.73% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Appleton Partners Inc sold 2,508 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 142,795 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $23.96 million, down from 145,303 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Appleton Partners Inc who had been investing in Apple Inc Com for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $937.32 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.82% or $1.58 during the last trading session, reaching $190.7. About 18.00M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 14, 2017 and is uptrending.
